verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a Platform Portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or command interface, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such capability. The llms.txt docs index, the OpenAPI spec, and the Zapier no-code webhook workflows are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not natural-language operation of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
